details.mending: Mending — note Instantaneous: nothing to track. You repair the target item. You restore 5 Hit Points per spell rank to the target, potentially removing the Broken condition if this repairs it past the item's Broken Threshold. You can't replace lost pieces or repair an object that's been completely destroyed. The module doesn't enforce this spell's rules; resolve them at the table.
